root.label: Template argument deduction
root.note: Match each parameter type P against its argument type A, independently, then require agreement.

children.label: P/A adjustments
children.note: Both sides are adjusted to reflect how the argument is passed.

children.label: By value
children.note: Arrays and functions decay to pointers; top-level cv on A is dropped.

children.label: By reference
children.note: The referred-to type is matched; arrays and const survive.

children.label: Forwarding reference
children.note: T&& with an lvalue deduces T as an lvalue reference.

children.label: Exact match rules
children.note: Deduction never considers implicit conversions.

children.label: Conflicts fail
children.note: biggest(1, 2.5) deduces int and double for T, so deduction fails.

children.label: Allowed differences
children.note: Extra cv through references, qualification conversions, and derived-to-base.

children.label: No user conversions
children.note: Wrapper<T> cannot be deduced from an int through a converting constructor.

children.label: Non-deduced contexts
children.note: Positions from which deduction learns nothing.

children.label: Nested names
children.note: Anything left of :: such as typename Id<T>::type.

children.label: Expressions
children.note: decltype operands and template arguments like A<N + 1>.

children.label: type_identity_t
children.note: Blocks deduction on purpose so that parameter accepts conversions.

children.label: Other sources
children.note: Deduction also runs outside ordinary typed arguments.

children.label: Braced lists
children.note: Deduce only into std::initializer_list<T> or a reference to an array.

children.label: Function addresses
children.note: A target function pointer type deduces the template's arguments.

children.label: Overload set arguments
children.note: Trial deduction per member; more than one success makes it non-deduced.

children.label: Conversion templates
children.note: operator T() deduces T from the required type, reference and cv stripped.

children.label: Explicit and default
children.note: Arguments not deduced must come from somewhere.

children.label: Explicit from left
children.note: Given arguments fill leading parameters; fully specified parameters convert.

children.label: Defaults last resort
children.note: A default template argument is used only if nothing was deduced or given.

children.label: After deduction
children.note: Substitution and the relatives that reuse the rules.

children.label: Deduction failure
children.note: Invalid types in the immediate context drop the candidate: SFINAE.

children.label: Hard errors
children.note: Errors in instantiated bodies, such as for auto return types, are not SFINAE.

children.label: auto and CTAD
children.note: auto deduces like a template parameter; CTAD deduces from constructors and guides.
